text.zh-CN:
过敏性鼻炎是鼻黏膜对花粉、尘螨等产生过敏反应。

- 常见鼻痒、连续喷嚏、清水鼻涕和鼻塞，也可眼痒流泪。
- 反复鼻塞会影响睡眠和专注，不是每次都在“感冒”。
text.en:
Allergic rhinitis is nasal inflammation triggered by allergens such as pollen or dust mites.

- Itching, repeated sneezing, watery discharge and blockage may accompany itchy eyes.
- Recurring blockage can disturb sleep and concentration rather than representing repeated colds.

text.zh-CN:
免疫系统把通常无害的物质当成威胁。

- 花粉可造成季节性发作；尘螨、宠物皮屑或霉菌可全年接触。
- 家族有过敏、本人有湿疹或哮喘时更易发生。
- 木屑、面粉等职业暴露也可能相关，应记录工作日与休息日差别。
text.en:
The immune system reacts to usually harmless substances.

- Pollen may produce seasonal symptoms; mites, animal dander and mould may persist year-round.
- Allergy family history, eczema and asthma increase likelihood.
- Workplace dusts may matter; compare working and non-working days.

text.zh-CN:
单纯鼻炎不应造成严重全身反应。

- 突然舌喉肿胀、喘不过气或晕倒，按严重过敏呼叫急救。
- 原有哮喘明显加重，不能只治疗鼻塞。
- 眼痛、视力改变或明显全身不适需要另行评估，不能一概归为过敏。
text.en:
Simple rhinitis should not explain severe systemic symptoms.

- Sudden throat swelling, breathing difficulty or collapse requires emergency allergy care.
- Worsening asthma needs more than nasal treatment.
- Eye pain, vision change or substantial systemic illness needs assessment beyond presumed allergy.

text.zh-CN:
症状是否影响生活比喷嚏次数更重要。

- 轻症可先请药师指导用药和减少接触。
- 影响睡眠、学习或工作，或常规治疗不见效，应就诊。
- 原因不明、反复单侧症状或伴哮喘恶化，需要医生重新判断。
text.en:
Impact matters more than a sneeze count.

- A pharmacist can guide mild symptoms and exposure reduction.
- Seek review for impaired sleep, school or work, or ineffective treatment.
- Unclear causes, persistent one-sided symptoms or worsening asthma need reassessment.

text.zh-CN:
诊断结合症状与暴露规律。

- 医生会问季节、宠物、居住环境及职业，并检查鼻腔。
- 必要时做皮肤或血液过敏检测，帮助找相关触发物。
- 检测阳性仅表示敏感，仍需结合实际接触后是否发病。
text.en:
Diagnosis combines symptoms and exposure patterns.

- Clinicians ask about season, pets, home and work and examine the nose.
- Skin or blood allergy tests may identify relevant triggers.
- A positive test indicates sensitization and must match the actual history.

text.zh-CN:
鼻塞流涕并不都由过敏引起。

- 普通感冒常伴咽痛、乏力，并在一段病程后好转。
- 烟雾、温湿度变化也能引起非过敏性鼻炎。
- 鼻窦炎或结构问题可导致持续鼻塞，需要查体而非不断换抗过敏药。
text.en:
Not all blockage or discharge is allergic.

- Colds often include sore throat and fatigue followed by recovery.
- Smoke and temperature or humidity changes can cause non-allergic rhinitis.
- Sinus or structural problems may need examination rather than repeated allergy-drug switching.

text.zh-CN:
治疗目标是让鼻子通畅、减少痒和恢复睡眠。

- 针对明确过敏原减少接触，而非清除家里所有物品。
- 抗组胺药或鼻用激素可控制症状，盐水清洗可辅助。
- 部分持续严重病例由专科评估免疫治疗，以降低对特定过敏原的敏感。
text.en:
Treatment improves airflow, itching and sleep.

- Reduce identified exposures rather than removing everything from the home.
- Antihistamines or nasal steroids control symptoms; saline can assist.
- Specialists may consider immunotherapy for selected persistent disease to reduce specific sensitivity.

text.zh-CN:
鼻用药物的作用各不相同。

- 抗组胺药主要缓解喷嚏和痒，部分会嗜睡。
- 鼻用激素控制局部炎症，应按说明规律使用。
- 减充血鼻喷仅短期用；本页NHS建议不超过5天，过用可能反而鼻塞。
text.en:
Nasal medicines have different roles.

- Antihistamines reduce itching and sneezing; some cause drowsiness.
- Nasal steroids control local inflammation with regular correct use.
- Decongestant sprays are short-term: this NHS guidance limits them to five days because overuse worsens blockage.

text.zh-CN:
一般不需要因为鼻炎全面忌口。

- 花粉或尘螨过敏不自动意味着牛奶、鸡蛋或海鲜过敏。
- 如果吃特定食物后口腔痒或肿胀，要单独记录并咨询。
- 没有足够依据把保健食品当作鼻炎治疗的替代品。
text.en:
Rhinitis usually does not require broad food avoidance.

- Pollen or mite allergy does not automatically imply milk, egg or seafood allergy.
- Record and discuss mouth itching or swelling after particular foods separately.
- Supplements should not replace established rhinitis treatment.

text.zh-CN:
护理要针对自己的触发物。

- 用盐水清洗时使用无菌、蒸馏或煮沸冷却的水，保持器具清洁。
- 花粉高时减少暴露，回家后清理身上花粉。
- 尘螨或宠物相关者清洗寝具、湿布除尘，并减少宠物进入卧室。
text.en:
Match care to your triggers.

- Use sterile, distilled or boiled-and-cooled water for saline rinsing and keep equipment clean.
- Limit high-pollen exposure and remove pollen after returning home.
- For mite or pet triggers, wash bedding, damp-dust and keep pets out of bedrooms.

text.zh-CN:
选药要兼顾年龄和其他疾病。

- 儿童使用年龄合适的产品，6岁以下不要自行用减充血药。
- 孕哺期先问医生或药师哪些产品合适。
- 哮喘患者应同时管理上下呼吸道，嗜睡药可能影响驾驶和学习。
text.en:
Choose medicines for age and other circumstances.

- Use age-appropriate products; do not self-use decongestants below age six.
- Ask about suitable products during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
- Manage asthma alongside rhinitis; sedating medicines may impair driving or learning.

text.zh-CN:
症状可随暴露反复，不一定能一次治愈。

- 记录症状、用药和暴露有助于评估疗效。
- 治疗无效时先核对喷鼻方法和坚持情况，再由医生调整。
- 随访也要询问睡眠、日间疲倦和哮喘是否控制。
text.en:
Symptoms may recur with exposure rather than resolve permanently.

- Record symptoms, treatment and exposures.
- Check technique and regular use before clinician-directed changes.
- Follow-up should also address sleep, daytime fatigue and asthma control.

text.zh-CN:
主要负担通常是长期不舒服和功能受影响。

- 鼻塞可造成睡眠不佳、白天疲倦。
- 可能合并鼻窦或耳部问题，需要按新症状评估。
- 过敏性鼻炎常与哮喘共存，出现喘息不能当作普通鼻塞。
text.en:
The main burden is persistent discomfort and impaired function.

- Blockage may disturb sleep and cause daytime fatigue.
- Sinus or ear problems can coexist and need assessment of new symptoms.
- Rhinitis often coexists with asthma; wheezing is not simply nasal blockage.

text.zh-CN:
预防重点是降低发作和接触，而非承诺不再过敏。

- 依据检测和病史选择实际可行的环境措施。
- 保持室内干燥，处理潮湿霉菌，避免烟雾刺激。
- 需要季节性治疗时提前与医生制定方案，勿长期依赖减充血鼻喷。
text.en:
Prevention aims to reduce exposure and attacks, not promise elimination.

- Use practical measures guided by history and testing.
- Address damp and mould and avoid smoke irritation.
- Plan seasonal treatment with a clinician rather than relying on prolonged decongestant sprays.
